checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
must.why: Front papers and cup are gone, but the papers/folder behind the laptop remain (the assistant admitted this).

must.item: Laptop, mug and cables intact in original positions.
must.why: Laptop, mug, mouse and cables look unchanged and in place.

must.item: Exposed desk areas have believable texture and lighting without fragments.
must.why: Wood grain fills cleanly with a faint slightly smoother patch but no leftover fragments.
Framing, window, wall and monitor arm are unchanged.

faults.what: Papers/folder behind the laptop remain; the user said 'the papers', so this is partial, though the assistant disclosed it.
Slight smooth patch on the wood where the cup and napkin stood.

summary: The front papers, cup and napkin were removed cleanly and everything else was preserved, but the papers behind the laptop remain, so the request is only partly done.
